description: This file defines a composable UI component named NiaTopicTag used for displaying topic tags in the Android app, with styling based on follow state, including theme previews and default styling constants.

classes.name: NiaTagDefaults
classes.description: Object holding default styling constants for the topic tags, such as alpha transparency values for container backgrounds.
